scene.model_scope: fixed-height spherical-sector arm proxy; independent sequential one-arm tasks; no IK, joint path, or hardware validation

validation.scope: base AABB-inflation collision and spherical-sector reachability proxy only; no IK

precheck.interpretation: Only the current finite candidate set, proxy, and roadmap are tested.

certificate.scope: Fixed-height spherical-sector independent-arm proxy; collision-checked static undirected corridor roadmap; no IK, arm collision, dynamics, or hardware certification.
certificate.conditional_completeness: Static finite proxy coverage; a bidirectionally depot-reachable candidate for every task; independent tasks; no time, capacity, or resource constraints.
certificate.cost_bound: Only against the named, validated anchor on this identical instance and objective.

timing.scope: New CPU wall time for this adapter call, including preprocessing, all attempted searches and validations; excludes process imports and JSON file I/O.
